none: PAS LANCUM-0E1781: Roman silver denarius of Geta
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is P SEPT GETA PIVS AVG BRIT ; R/ is VICTORIAE BRIT

Roman silver denarius of Geta dating to the period AD 210 to 212 (Reece Period 10). Cf RIC 4 (Geta), 92. The diameter is 19mm, and the weight is 2.70g. Obverse inscription is P SEPT GETA PIVS AVG BRIT and the reverse inscription is VICTORIAE BRIT
